title: 2026-11-07 论文推荐
description: 10 篇推荐：FlashOffloading (Huawei, 全阶段卸载 KV cache + 零开销稀疏索引：30ms TPOT 下 prefill 1.38×、decode 1.91×。)、FastAFD (University of California, San Diego, 机架级 NVLink 上 AFD 只赢 1.16–1.17 倍，但三步分解模型能在部署前算清这笔账。)、Resource-Efficient Reinforcement Learning Post-Training through Elastic Expert Parallelism (Tsinghua University, MoE RL 后训练的三分之一占用是等专家：弹性释放 worker，同算力下多产 65% token、吞吐 +52.74%。)、LowRAM (Huawei Noah's Ark Lab, value 可由 key 预测：残差存储 + 跨层低秩 key，4× 近无损、吞吐 5×，叠量化后 26.9×。)、TriAttention (University of North Texas, 三态注意力（跳过/4-bit/8-bit）+ 与长度无关的边界策略：端到端 7.88×，质量不掉。)。

highlights.name: FlashOffloading: Low-Latency KV Cache Offloading for Long-Context LLM Serving
highlights.note: 全阶段卸载 KV cache + 零开销稀疏索引：30ms TPOT 下 prefill 1.38×、decode 1.91×。

highlights.name: LowRAM: Low-Rank Keys and Amortised Values for Composable KV Cache Compression at Test-Time
highlights.note: value 可由 key 预测：残差存储 + 跨层低秩 key，4× 近无损、吞吐 5×，叠量化后 26.9×。

highlights.name: KOSMOS: Self-scheduling Persistent Kernels for Communication-Compute Overlap
highlights.note: 持久 kernel + 需求序队列自调度：Megatron 训练 1.10–1.28×，EP 场景比 DeepEP 快 1.29–1.83×。
